results.title: Hour-by-Hour Forecast for New York, New York, USA
New York Weather in August
excerpts:
In August, New York typically sees overnight lows around 20°C, rising to daytime highs of around 28°C. Based on 18 years of records, the lowest temperature recorded was 17.8°C, and the highest was 30.7°C.
How much does it rain in New York in August?
August in New York sees an average of 124mm of rain, spread across around 9 days. The heaviest single day of rain recorded in our data for August was 377.5mm, based on 18 years of records.
Is it windy in New York in August?
August has an average wind speed of 3mph in New York, with gusts reaching up to 5mph based on historical records.
How sunny is New York in August?
New York averages around 228.8 hours of sunshine per day in August, based on historical records.

results.title: NY Rain Data — New York Rainfall & Precipitation Tracker | Value Add VC
excerpts: How much rain does New York City get per year? 49.9 inches is the average annual rainfall in New York City based on 30-year climate normals. Central Park has recorded as much as 67 inches in wet years and as little as 35 inches in drought years. The dashboard tracks monthly and annual totals against historical averages. What is the rainiest month in New York? 4.5 inches is the average rainfall in July, making it historically the wettest month in New York City. April through September accounts for roughly 55% of annual precipitation. The dashboard breaks down monthly rainfall patterns going back multiple decades. How does upstate New York rainfall compare to NYC? 36-50 inches per year is the range across New York State, with significant variation by region. VC Value Add VC ⚡ Home
